retained_foundations.statement: One supplied original D7, its normalized-type record, and actual adelic SG.HidaSetting X with original measures, fields, lattice, frames and representations. This is not the ordinary Hecke-algebra HidaSetting. Their common-family existence is not claimed.
The full original RowsFinDim, explicitly assumed in ARO18 and all later constructions using finite multiplicities; no new proof of general automorphic finite multiplicity is asserted.
Original AutTie, RowDictTie and LabTie on the same X,G,iota. Their actual simultaneous global producer remains open.
Exact CountIdempotentsClass(PCount,D,n0,A,C,c3,cb), used only as a supplied antecedent in ARO28 and ARO30. It is not reclassified as a published foundation or claimed completed.

Discrete valuation lattice bases, Nakayama and Chinese remaindering; Haar measure facts, Riesz representation, Fubini and elementary unitary representation algebra. Their exact consumers and normalization calculations are proved in the numbered text.
